Ukraine hits the Kerch bridge between Russia and occupied Crimea in an overnight drone barrage, and Andy Burnham is set to say Brexit 'has not worked'.
text.international: An investigation reveals Israel uploaded millions of photos to Amazon's facial recognition platform to track Palestinians during its bombardment of Gaza. Ukraine hits the Kerch bridge between Russia and occupied Crimea in an overnight drone barrage, briefly restricting traffic. Trump backs calls to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia's chief executive, and China says Xi, Trump and Putin will discuss 'world peace' at a three-way meeting.
